title: デビュー戦の後に・風のはじまり

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I go to see Yamanin Zephyr after her spectacular debut race, but upon finding her…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …I felt a sure wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The scent of fresh turf, the passion in the air, the springing dirt… And blowing amidst them all, a wind…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: During the race, I was that wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I may have been faint and weak, and far from my ideal self, but… I really was the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes… It was here. It could only ever have happened here!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's just as she said—it had to be on the track.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's through the Twinkle Series that I can become the true wind!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Let's hurry back to the academy and discuss my next race, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I won't let this wind die down. Let's decide where it will blow next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she speaks in a calm tone, I sense the remnant lows of a tempest in her words. Unwittingly overwhelmed, I can't help but nod.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crucial part of her career starts now. The sprints, the miles, the Classic Triple Crown tour… And there's also the Triple Tiara tour to consider.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are several paths available to runners. Of all the options, Yamanin Zephyr should go for…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The mile tour, without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I even ask for her input, Yamanin Zephyr makes her intentions clear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I nod. If we're going to make the most of her speed, it would be best to go for either sprints or miles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But for her, I'm guessing that what matters even more is choosing a tour she'll win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's because she has her own ideal to strive for…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'll take first place in the G1 Yasuda Kinen. Then, I'll dominate the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It will be as if a tempest has been unleashed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If we're to catch up with the one who has earned the title of "Mile Emperor"…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: We will need to walk the wind stream once again—into the midst of the storm, where blistering speeds await.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Showing no hesitation whatsoever, she declares that conquering the mile tour is her sole priority.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, we need to decide on some concrete goal races. I'd like to focus on miles, while also entering her in some sprints to further raise her innate speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If the choice is between mile or sprint races, then for our first goal…
choice_data_list: Let's enter the New Zealand Trophy.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The spring G2 race? That's…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That's… going to leave us waiting a long time for the wind to blow…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A touch. But still…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I know what you're thinking, Trainer. I do feel the wind coming off of you, even now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I feel a comforting breeze looking out for me. …Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: All right. The New Zealand Trophy it is.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That's where I shall next become the spring gale.
